acceptance: Adding a setup step to one medium-suite job and not the others fails a fast check, either because the jobs share one setup definition (a composite action or reusable workflow) or because a parity test compares their setup steps.
The check is shown to work by removing the `_project/scripts` sync from one job and seeing it fail.
description: The medium suite runs in four jobs that each define their own setup: `medium-test` in `ci.yml`; `medium-test` in `trunk.yml` and in `trunk-coverage.yml`, which `ci.yml` calls as `trunk-lane-plain` and `trunk-lane-coverage`; and the core integration suite in `nightly-v2.yml`. On #3725, the locked `_project/scripts` sync that the tracker runtime handshake test needs was added to `ci.yml` and `nightly-v2.yml` but not to the two trunk workflows. `tests/unit/workflows` passed (1,033 tests). The gap showed only when the full CI run failed both trunk-lane `medium-test (shard 0)` jobs. The trunk lanes run on PRs, so they caught this before merge; the same drift in `nightly-v2.yml` would show only in the nightly run.
